title: Washington Post 'Lucky to be alive' article on people who skipped work on 9/11

tellings.quote: there was an article called lucky to be alive in the Washington Post that actually told the stories of people who hadn't gone to work that day

plain: In 2001 the Washington Post ran an article called "Lucky to be alive" that told the stories of people who did not go to work in New York on the day of the September 11 attacks. The biologist Rupert Sheldrake brings it up as he talks about people who seem to sense danger before it comes, since if such stories hold, some people may have a feeling for what is about to happen.
